bundle.shortDescription: A confidential inference control plane with a local model runtime
bundle.longDescription: Cordon runs a local language model behind identity, policy, output filtering, a tamper-evident audit log and signed responses. The desktop app ships llama.cpp, downloads a model, and opens the operator console.
